verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The arm now defers before any PR mutation when the fresh pre-mutation REST snapshot explicitly reports `mergeable: false`. That predicate is co-extensive with the existing strict tri-state used by conflict enumeration and live rebase admission; unknown or malformed values do not manufacture a conflict. The conflict exit precedes both CI exits, leaves their per-head budgets unspent, emits a SHA-bound App-authenticated receipt, and does not bind the reviewed SHA. The added tests exercise the pure decision, both fresh-read race directions, mutation-free end-to-end refusal, mergeable and unknown controls, CI precedence, receipt idempotency, census reporting, and dispatch-claim parity with locally specified expectations. No reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff.
